title: Food Processing Franchise Opportunity
tagline: Tellicherry Spicelabs Pvt. Ltd. is a research-based food and spices company expanding its products across Indian cities under the FOCO (Franchisee Owned, Company Operated) model. We also have our own food brand, which is successfully operating on Swiggy and Zomato, and we are now looking to expand our presence across India. Under this model, franchise owners are responsible only for processing the spices at their factory, while the company manages the franchise operations. The company is seeking franchise investors for single or multiple outlets. The franchisee owns the outlet, while the company takes complete responsibility for its operations and maintenance. The monthly revenue and EBITDA margin may appear high because the business has a vast network of distributors, restaurants, and hotels. Once the spices are processed, the products are supplied to these established clients, supporting strong sales and profitability. The business holds a valid GST certificate and incorporation certificate.
